contribution_requirements: Follow Next.js 14 App Router conventions. Use TypeScript strict mode. Match design system exactly: primary #166534, secondary #65A30D, accent #F59E0B, Inter font. All components must be responsive (375px/768px/1440px). Use Zustand for state management. All API calls through centralized axios client with JWT interceptor.
key_patterns: Backend uses: JWT in Authorization header (verifyAccessToken), Role enum (CUSTOMER/SELLER/ADMIN), Prisma models (User, Product, Order, Cart, etc.), response format {success:boolean, data/error}. Protected routes require authenticate middleware. Seller routes require requireSeller. Products have slug-based URLs. Pagination via query params ?page=&limit=. Categories cached aggressively (1 hour). User-specific cart/wishlist cached per user.
